forbidden: This page is for Puntr admins.

resync.title: Re-sync from the data provider
resync.body: Runs the fixture and result syncs now. It uses calls from the provider's daily quota.
resync.done: Fixtures: {{fcalls}} calls, {{fupserted}} updated. Results: {{rcalls}} calls, {{rupserted}} updated.

error.not_configured: SPORTS_API_KEY is not set on the server.
error.error: The sync failed. Check the server logs.

csv.title: CSV import
csv.body: For fixtures the data provider misses. Every row is checked first; if any row is wrong nothing is imported. Re-importing the same row updates it.
csv.label: CSV

error.invalid: The file has problems. Nothing was imported.
error.error: Something went wrong. Nothing was imported.

title: Admin

settle.title: Settlement
settle.overview: Final matches with picks waiting for a first settlement
settle.none: Nothing is waiting. Picks settle automatically within minutes of a result.
settle.noScore: No score yet: it can't be graded automatically.
settle.error: Could not settle. Check the server logs.

manual.title: Correct or settle a pick
manual.body: A correction is written as a new entry with your reason and name. The earlier entries stay on the record.

reports.title: Reports
reports.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

users.title: Moderation
users.hideBody: The pick leaves the public feed but stays in the record and in /verify. Write the reason.
users.hideError: Couldn't hide that pick. Check the ID.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.empty: The waitlist is empty. The earlier sign-ups still need importing into this project.
waitlist.note: Invites are sent by the script (bun run waitlist:invite), not from here. Do not send until the attorney has agreed the approach.

launch.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

notice.body: Send this to the early-access list on WhatsApp and SMS today. Personalised one-tap links are on the Waitlist tab.

emails.title: Early-access emails
emails.off: Sending is switched off. Set LAUNCH_EMAILS_ENABLED=true on the server when you are ready.
emails.notConfigured: The email service keys are not set on the server.
emails.note: Emails go out at 08:00 on each date (SAST) to people who have not signed up yet, were not unsubscribed and have no privacy request. Reminders 1 and 2 go only to people who ticked marketing on the early-access form.

draft.title: Founding sign-ups message draft
draft.body: The system never sends this. On the day Founding sign-ups open it appears here as a notification and is emailed to you, and you send it yourself.

audience.title: Early-access list ({{count}})
audience.showAll: Show people who have signed up
audience.note: One-tap links open WhatsApp or your SMS app with the message filled in. Only people who opted in to marketing get links; the rest are email only.
audience.notOptedIn: Did not opt in to marketing
audience.badPhone: No usable South African number. Check it by hand.

rewards.error: Something went wrong. Check the values and try again.

settings.title: Switches
settings.body: Everything is off until you turn it on. Rules and rewards below are proposals you can edit first.
settings.points_enabledHint: Master switch. Nothing is awarded and referrals stay pending while it is off.
settings.rewards_enabledHint: Shows the catalogue and allows redemption of active rewards.
settings.betting_vouchers_enabledHint: A gambling promotion. Keep off until counsel signs off and a licensed partner funds them. Only 18+, email-confirmed members see them.

rules.title: Earning rules
rules.body: Points reward activity, never results. A blank cap means no cap. Each rule needs its own Active tick.

catalogue.title: Rewards catalogue
catalogue.body: New rewards start inactive. Voucher rewards use the codes you upload; others use a stock number or no limit.
catalogue.name: Name

adjust.title: Adjust points
adjust.body: Written as a new ledger row with your name and reason. It never edits an earlier row.
adjust.negative: That would take the balance below zero.

referrals.title: Referral review
referrals.body: Recent invites. A flag means one member qualified several friends within an hour.

identity.title: Identity checks
identity.intro: Compare each document with the member's name and birth year. The document is deleted as soon as you decide. Never copy an ID number anywhere.
identity.name: Name on Puntr
identity.done: Saved. The document has been deleted.
identity.error: That didn't save. Please try again.

campaigns.title: Campaign tracking
campaigns.body: Unique visitors per ad (utm_content) through the Founding sign-up funnel. Tag every ad link with utm_source, utm_campaign and utm_content.
campaigns.empty: No tracked visits in this period yet.
campaigns.error: Couldn't load campaign data. If this is new, apply the campaign_events migration in Supabase.
campaigns.note: Counts only visitors who accepted Analytics. Founding spots taken counts everyone, so compare the two to estimate untracked sign-ups. Times are rolling from now.

affiliates.title: Affiliate partners
affiliates.body: Track applications, terms, licence checks and go-live for every partner. Links and creatives may only run for partners marked Live.
affiliates.rules: Rules: a bookmaker goes Live only with a recorded provincial licence check. Every gambling creative is labelled Ad with 18+, T&Cs apply and 0800 006 008. Never put personal information in a partner link. Commission terms are confidential to Puntr.
affiliates.error: Couldn't save. Check the details and try again.
affiliates.needLicence: A bookmaker can only be Live once a licence check date is recorded.
affiliates.licencePending: Licence check not recorded yet: cannot go Live.

f.name: Partner name
f.trackingHint: Use only the link the partner provides. No personal information in it.
f.licenceNotes: Licence check notes (licence number, province, source)

log.title: Activity
log.placeholder: Add a note, email, call or payment

draw.title: R500 OTT voucher draw
draw.body: Entries are Founding Members who tried Practice Mode at least once and submitted the feedback survey with the draw box ticked. The system picks one winner at random and records the draw.
draw.closed: Closed: a draw can be run
draw.loadError: Couldn't load the draw. Check that the practice_mode migration is applied.
draw.runBody: Run it once, after the draw closes, with a witness present. The result is saved in the draw log. Type DRAW to confirm.
draw.notClosed: The draw closes when Puntr goes live on Tuesday 1 December 2026. It cannot be run before then.
draw.announce: Announce by username and Founding number only: @{{username}}, Founding Member #{{number}}. Tell the winner by email, or by phone if a number was given. Never publish contact details.

error.not_closed: The draw has not closed yet.
error.failed: The draw could not be run. Please try again.

members.subject: Subject
members.alsoEmail: Also send by email (queued within the daily email limit)
members.daysHint: Leave empty for no end date (access grants only)
members.creditsHint: Positive adds credits, negative removes them. A balance can never go below zero.
members.restrictHint: Limit pauses picks and PuntPoints transfers. Suspend blocks the account for the number of days. Ban has no end date. Admin accounts cannot be restricted.
members.broadcastBody: Shows in every member's notifications. Emails go into the outbox and are sent in batches so the daily email limit is never passed.

system.noPfie: No fixtures check has run yet.
system.outbox: Email outbox: {{queued}} waiting, {{sentToday}} sent today, {{failed}} failed
system.quotasBody: Each service stops for the day (or month) when its cap is reached; nothing switches to a paid fallback. Rows turn yellow at 80%.
system.settingsBody: Launch time is stored in UTC (1 December 00:00 SAST is 2026-11-30T22:00:00Z). Until then only admins and members with Early access can use the live features.
system.scoringBody: Points for a correct pick. A change applies only to picks settled afterwards and is recorded.

log.title: Action log
log.body: Every change made from the admin portal, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

analytics.dailyNote: Hover a bar for visitors and sign-ups that day.
analytics.consent: Visitor and event figures count only visitors who accepted analytics cookies, so they undercount real traffic.

desk.generateBody: Runs the research and writing pipeline now. Each article takes up to a minute and lands in the review queue unless automatic publishing is on and it passes every check.
desk.generateNote: A Puntr update needs at least one approved entry in the project-update feed below. Every run uses the API limits on the System tab.
desk.autoPublish: Publish automatically when all checks pass
desk.engineNote: Recommended for the first week: daily article on, automatic publishing off, so every article is read before it goes out.

f.title: Title
f.updateDetail: Details, as members should read them (facts only)

desk.criticalWarning: This article failed a critical check. Fix or verify it against the sources before publishing.
desk.updatesBody: Puntr news articles are written only from approved entries here. Never add anything that has not happened.
desk.publishCriticalConfirm_one: This article failed {{count}} critical check. Publishing it puts unchecked claims on the site. Publish anyway?
desk.publishCriticalConfirm_other: This article failed {{count}} critical checks. Publishing it puts unchecked claims on the site. Publish anyway?

notify.title: Send an in-app notification
notify.body: Appears in the bell for signed-in members, live for anyone online. Use it for updates, reminders and announcements. For email, use Users > Message members.
notify.linkField: Link (optional): /founding, /practice or a full https:// address
notify.scheduleHint: Your local time. Leave empty to send now. Scheduled notices appear when the time comes (members see them next time the bell refreshes).
notify.error: Could not send. Check the fields and try again.
notify.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this notification? It disappears from every member's bell.

pass.title: Founding Annual Pass
pass.body: 20 passes in total. PayFast holds, paid passes and bank transfers all count toward the cap. The public counter updates within a minute.
pass.recordBody: For members who paid by EFT. It counts toward the 20 straight away. Match it to the member's username once you know who paid; their pass then shows as paid.
pass.linked: Matched. The member's pass is now paid.
pass.voidConfirm: Void this transfer? It will stop counting toward the 20.

badges.title: Team badges
badges.body: Rule: every team must show its real badge. Badges are found with Parallel Search (the club's Wikipedia article and its crest), checked, and copied to Puntr's storage. Fixtures and results whose teams have no verified badge are hidden from members until a badge is verified or set here.
badges.summary: {{total}} teams in fixtures · {{missing}} without a verified badge
badges.rejectConfirm: Reject the badge for {{team}}? Its fixtures are hidden until you set a badge by hand.
